evidence.summary: The US Treasury describes the Gromov Flight Research Institute, a research and development centre with ground and flight test complexes, as a subsidiary of United Aircraft Corporation (UAC), which it calls a Rostec subsidiary and the holding company for Russia’s aircraft builders, Sukhoi and MiG among them. OFAC lists it in Zhukovsky.
It belongs to United Aircraft Corporation (UAC), a subsidiary of the Russian state corporation Rostec.
